name: commonslens
title: CommonsLens
subtitle: Discover, explore, and reuse Wikimedia Commons media
description: CommonsLens is a free, independent, open-source web application for discovering, exploring, organizing, and reusing Wikimedia Commons media. It combines advanced media search, Wikimedia structured-data and metadata filtering, geographic exploration, interactive multimedia inspection including 3D models, licensing and attribution assistance, browser-local collections, and integrity-verified bulk downloads. Its visual, no-code pipeline builder enables users to combine queries, filter and transform results, and export structured metadata datasets through repeatable, ETL-style workflows. CommonsLens supports comprehensive CSV metadata exports from searches, collections, author portfolios, and visual pipelines, with configurable fields and image links. Designed for researchers, educators, archivists, journalists, content creators, and Wikimedia enthusiasts, CommonsLens runs directly in the browser without requiring an account or payment. It does not operate advertising trackers, analytics, or a centralized user database and is not affiliated with the Wikimedia Foundation.
